description.en: 基于 Claude Code 的长篇网文辅助创作系统，解决 AI 写作中的「遗忘」和「幻觉」问题，支持 200 万字量级 连载创作。
A team of long-lived bots for DeepSeek Harness, with main bots, bot-to-bot messages and group chats.
DSH 技能调用审计 + 应用内 skill 管理器
Connect CommandCode Go accounts to DSH with account rotation and subscription usage displays.

One-click restart of the DSH service from Settings → General. A dsh-plugin for DeepSeek Harness; the restart row stays pinned at the bottom of the general settings page.  在设置 → 通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务。DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-plugin，重启行固定显示在通用设置页面最底部。
description.zh: 在设置→通用设置中一键重启 DSH 服务，重启按钮固定在页面底部，方便快捷。

DSH 日报插件：每日主动推荐多类型新闻，可用自然语言调教推荐偏好，提供含网页 / YouTube / 哔哩哔哩视频的高价值索引，并在右侧栏以常驻网页呈现、点击即达。
给当前 DSH 的全部会话与子代理统一附加一段额外说明和上下文：设置页分段维护、实时预览、热生效。

DeepSeek Harness plugin: DejaVu memory client — automated long-term memory (boot/read/search/create/update/delete) backed by your own DejaVu MCP server.

Telegram channel for DeepSeek Harness — real Telegram markdown, and answer the agent's questions and approvals straight from chat
A6API 多模型聚合站接入插件：原生 LLM 提供商注册、账户实时余额与价格波动监控、Token 白名单同步、商户线路探测与全景指标卡片
为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏会话补充官方缺失的「删除会话」：运行中置灰、二次确认、真删除。 A DeepSeek Harness plugin adding the missing Delete-session action to the sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上官方缺失的删除会话功能，运行中置灰、二次确认、真删除。

description.en: Adds configurable reasoning levels for third-party models and a model-strength picker in the composer.
description.zh: 为第三方模型配置推理强度档位，并在输入栏提供模型与强度选择器。

description.en: Reasoning-effort gear presets for third-party models: 16 vendor/model presets with per-mode custom wire values, written into dsh-llm-pi-ai with pre-write validation and per-rule rejection; per-model switching between OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages with automatic route regrouping; plus a composer Optimize button and a settings section that rewrite the input text with a model you pick.
description.zh: 第三方模型的思考档位预设：内置 16 组按「厂家 → 模型」组织的官方档位，支持自定义档位与逐模式传输值，校验后直写 llm-pi-ai 配置；支持按模型在 OpenAI Chat Completions、OpenAI Responses 与 Anthropic Messages 三种协议间切换并自动重新分组路由；输入框提供「优化提示词」按钮，用设置中指定的大模型改写当前内容。

description.en: Agnes Token Plan quota panel rendered as a config card on the Harness Plugins page: account-wide quota windows (5-hour requests, weekly requests, daily images, daily video) plus cumulative usage with a daily chart and the public plan catalogue, all read from the Agnes console API, with in-panel sign-in and automatic re-login. Four opt-in switches, off by default, register the Agnes models as an LLM provider, connect the AgnesCode desktop-app login state as a second upstream provider, and expose image- and video-generation tools to the agent.
description.zh: 在 Harness 的 Plugins 页以插件卡显示 Agnes 控制台的 Token Plan 额度：账号级四类额度窗口（5 小时请求、每周请求、每日图片、每日视频）、账号累计用量与按日柱图、以及公开套餐目录，支持面板内登录与令牌失效后自动重登。另有四个默认关闭的可选开关：把 Agnes 模型注册为 DSH 推理提供方、接入 AgnesCode 桌面端上游，并向 agent 暴露图片与视频生成工具。

description.en: MiMo voice for DeepSeek Harness — reads each finished answer aloud, turns composer dictation into text, and offers nine built-in voices plus a cloned-voice slot.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的小米 MiMo 语音插件：把每段回答念出来、把输入框里的口述变成文字，带 9 个内置音色和一个克隆音色槽位。

description.en: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimizer (three modes, 10 templates identical to upstream); history is consent-gated with version chains and structural comparison; every run reports its token usage. Nothing is written back or sent without a click.
description.zh: 把 DSH 输入框里的一句话补成完整任务书（角色/目标/约束/输出格式）。引擎是 linshenkx/prompt-optimizer 的逐字节移植：三种优化模式、10 个模板与上游一致；历史为授权制、带版本链与结构对比；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。未经点击不写回、不发送。

description.en: Composer prompt polisher: a button in the input tool row rewrites the current draft through the session model (workflow engine, enabled automatically) or an OpenAI-compatible standalone API with host-side key storage, backfills the rewritten text with a replace/give-up dialog when the draft changed mid-run, and ships concise/structured style presets, custom templates with a {draft} placeholder, one-click restore from the status dock and reference-chip protection.
description.zh: 输入框提示词优化：一键把当前草稿交给会话模型（自动启用 workflow 引擎）或 OpenAI 兼容独立 API（密钥只存宿主侧）改写并回填，草稿中途变更时弹出替换/放弃确认；提供 concise/structured 风格预设、自定义模板（{draft} 占位符）、状态条一键还原与引用记号保护。

description.en: Collapses the DSH Web sidebar panel menu (plugins, extensions, scheduled tasks, IM) from a vertical labelled list into a horizontal row of 36×36 icon buttons with hover tooltips; a Settings → General option switches back to the list and is remembered per browser.
description.zh: 把 dsh Web 侧边栏的全局面板菜单（插件、扩展管理、定时任务、IM）从竖排文字列表收起为一行 36×36 图标按钮，悬停显示名称；可在「设置 → 通用」里切回列表，选择按浏览器记忆。

description.en: A collapsible, draggable popup in the top-right corner of the DSH web interface for watching A-shares, ETFs, Hong Kong and US stocks and OKX spot crypto side by side: real-time quotes, intraday and daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts with moving averages, buy/sell target prices, group switching with drag-to-reorder, rename and delete, cross-market search, and light/dark themes. A fork of Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch that adds US quotes via Eastmoney and crypto via OKX.
description.zh: A 股 / ETF / 港股 / 美股 / 加密货币行情盯盘插件：在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 界面右上角显示可折叠、可拖动的弹窗，同时盯多个市场——实时行情、分时与日/周/月 K 线（含均线）、买卖目标价、分组管理（切换、拖动排序、重命名、删除）、跨市场搜索、明暗主题。fork 自 Awu12277/dsh-stock-watch，新增东方财富美股行情与 OKX 现货加密货币行情。

description.en: Restyles the DeepSeek Harness welcome area and composer, with workspace, mode, and skill shortcuts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 欢迎区和输入栏换肤，并提供工作区、模式与技能快捷入口。

description.en: Adds an Appearance switch to the DSH sidebar with a three-second time-stop transition, synchronized sound, and light/dark theme switching.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加入“外观”开关，切换明暗主题时播放三秒时停转场与同步音效。
在 DSH 里登录 VibeDev 账号，多出一组 Claude、GPT 等模型可选，还能生成图片视频音乐和播客。
